json.limits: Static review only; no code was executed. The requirement is qualitative (report readability and review threshold); its three named elements are structurally verifiable and all present: presentation.py emits '## 1. What changed / 这次改了什么' (goal, implementer handoff claims or an explicit 'no handoff supplied' notice, top-5 changed files with acceptance-related files sorted first, baseline caveats), '## 2. What checks found / 检查发现了什么' (per-check plain-language reason strings for FAIL/TIMEOUT/stale-log/invalid-test-report cases, test counts, pending checks), and '## 3. What you still need to decide / 还需要你判断什么' (translated statuses instead of raw enum codes, per-item questions, recorded feedback, concrete reply templates, guidance that the reader need not re-inspect every log). In cli.py, brief_report() output is placed before the '<details>' fold labeled 'Technical evidence (open when needed)', so the plain summary is read first; this matches the supplied tests' assertions (three headings in overview, no 'NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW'/'log_sha256' in overview, question appears exactly once, zh-CN/en language handling). Scope caveats: only presentation.py and a cli.py excerpt were reviewed — assessment()/counts construction and the '--lang' plumbing for report/status are not shown, so I assumed data keys ('goal', 'latest_checks', 'changes', check['usable'/'execution'/'workspace'/'log_integrity']) are always populated by the caller. Minor robustness observations not tied to this requirement and not demonstrable as failures: summary() indexes count['passed'/'failures'/'errors'/'skipped'] directly while using counts.get() for the same dict a few lines earlier, and data['latest_checks'] is required in summary() while report() falls back to data['checks'] — both would only matter for schemas I cannot inspect. The '降低审查门槛' (lower the review threshold) portion has no measurable oracle; my judgment that the plain-language summaries, folding, bilingual output, and reply templates satisfy it is qualitative, based on the affordances present in the code.

json.oracle_source: 让读报告的人先看懂：这次改了什么、检查发现了什么、还需要自己判断什么；降低审查门槛。
scenarios: English report: after `init` with a goal plus two edited files, `agentproof report` writes a plain three-part summary (What changed / What checks found / What you still need to decide) BEFORE the folded `<details>` technical evidence, and the three sections appear in that reading order.
Section 1 quotes the original request text and names the changed file paths, so the reader can compare the change against what was asked without opening evidence.

Each of the three sections carries at least one non-empty statement rather than bare headings — including the honest 'no checks recorded yet' state, so the reader always gets an answer to 'what checks found'.

A zh-CN report delivers the same three Chinese sections (这次改了什么 / 检查发现了什么 / 还需要你判断什么) before the fold, still naming the request and the changed files, so a Chinese reader is not forced through English evidence.
`agentproof status --brief` alone answers all three questions (sections in order, changed file named), lowering the barrier for readers who never open the full report.
json.test_code:
from probe_support import ProbeCase

EN = ("What changed", "What checks found", "What you still need to decide")
ZH = ("这次改了什么", "检查发现了什么", "还需要你判断什么")


class HandoffHelpers:
    def overview_of(self, content):
        self.assertIn("<details>", content,
                      "technical evidence must stay folded behind <details>")
        return content.split("<details>", 1)[0]

    def assert_three_sections_in_reading_order(self, text, sections):
        pos = []
        for section in sections:
            self.assertIn(section, text, "missing plain section: %r" % section)
            pos.append(text.index(section))
        self.assertLess(pos[0], pos[1], "wrong reading order for the three sections")
        self.assertLess(pos[1], pos[2], "wrong reading order for the three sections")

    def section_body(self, text, first, second):
        return text[text.index(first) + len(first):text.index(second)].strip()


class EnglishHandoffReport(HandoffHelpers, ProbeCase):
    def test_summary_precedes_folded_evidence_in_reading_order(self):
        code, out = self.cli("init", "--goal", "Stop retrying after a timeout", "--lang", "en")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, out)
        self.write("retry.py", "changed behavior")
        self.write("notes.md", "updated notes")
        code, out = self.cli("report")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, out)
        content = self.read(".agentproof/report.md")
        overview = self.overview_of(content)
        self.assert_three_sections_in_reading_order(overview, EN)
        self.assertLess(overview.index(EN[2]), content.index("<details>"),
                        "the decide section must be readable before the fold")
        self.assertIn("## Verification", content.split("<details>", 1)[1])

    def test_change_section_names_request_and_changed_files(self):
        goal = "Stop retrying after a timeout"
        code, out = self.cli("init", "--goal", goal, "--lang", "en")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, out)
        self.write("retry.py", "changed behavior")
        self.write("notes.md", "updated notes")
        code, out = self.cli("report")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, out)
        overview = self.overview_of(self.read(".agentproof/report.md"))
        body = self.section_body(overview, EN[0], EN[1])
        self.assertIn(goal, body)
        self.assertIn("retry.py", body)
        self.assertIn("notes.md", body)

    def test_each_section_carries_content_beyond_its_heading(self):
        code, out = self.cli("init", "--goal", "Stop retrying after a timeout", "--lang", "en")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, out)
        self.write("retry.py", "changed behavior")
        code, out = self.cli("report")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, out)
        overview = self.overview_of(self.read(".agentproof/report.md"))
        self.assertTrue(self.section_body(overview, EN[0], EN[1]),
                        "what-changed section must say something")
        self.assertTrue(self.section_body(overview, EN[1], EN[2]),
                        "checks section must state the check situation, even 'none recorded'")
        tail = overview[overview.index(EN[2]) + len(EN[2]):].strip()
        self.assertTrue(tail, "the decide section must tell the reader something")


class ChineseHandoffReport(HandoffHelpers, ProbeCase):
    def test_zh_cn_reader_gets_same_three_parts_before_the_fold(self):
        code, out = self.cli("init", "--goal", "修复重试超时", "--lang", "zh-CN")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, out)
        self.write("retry.py", "changed behavior")
        code, out = self.cli("report")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, out)
        content = self.read(".agentproof/report.md")
        overview = self.overview_of(content)
        self.assert_three_sections_in_reading_order(overview, ZH)
        self.assertLess(overview.index(ZH[2]), content.index("<details>"))
        body = self.section_body(overview, ZH[0], ZH[1])
        self.assertIn("修复重试超时", body)
        self.assertIn("retry.py", body)


class BriefStatusHandoff(HandoffHelpers, ProbeCase):
    def test_brief_status_answers_all_three_questions_without_full_report(self):
        code, out = self.cli("init", "--goal", "Stop retrying after a timeout", "--lang", "en")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, out)
        self.write("retry.py", "changed behavior")
        code, out = self.cli("status", "--brief")
        self.assertEqual(code, 0, out)
        self.assert_three_sections_in_reading_order(out, EN)
        self.assertIn("retry.py", out)
json.limits: (1) These probes cannot configure project checks or acceptance scenarios (that mechanism in the original harness uses an acceptance_config helper whose CLI/file contract is not given here), so per-check outcome wording (PASS/FAIL/stale/timeout reasons), acceptance-question rendering and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW flows remain unverified; the 'what checks found' section is only exercised in its no-checks-recorded state plus non-emptiness. (2) Heading anchors ('What changed' etc. / 这次改了什么 etc.) are the implementation's own titles that encode the three required questions; if wording is reworded the anchors must be updated — the order, placement-before-fold, goal/file-naming and non-empty-body assertions are wording-agnostic. (3) '降低审查门槛' beyond structure (plain summary first, evidence folded, brief status parity) is subjective and not asserted. (4) Commands used are only those demonstrated in the supplied tests (init --goal/--lang, report, status --brief); no network, no shell.
